title: Fund the Best Projects
statement:
You have starting capital `w` and may complete at most `k` different projects, one after another. Project `i` can be started only if your current capital is at least `c_i`; when finished, it adds `p_i` to your capital (the cost `c_i` is not spent, it is only a requirement).

Print the largest final capital you can reach.

## Input
The first line contains `n`, `k` and `w`. Each of the next `n` lines contains `c_i` and `p_i`.

## Output
Print the largest final capital.

## Constraints
- `1 <= k <= n <= 8000`
- `0 <= w, c_i <= 10^9`
- `0 <= p_i <= 10^9`
